value.signature: fn check_generation_indices (& self , rows : & mut Collected < 'a > , meter : & mut AuditMeter) -> Result < () , AuditFailure >

exception.justification: Justified: Memory index validation inherits the enclosing metered audit operation.

review.body: { for installed in & self . generations { let scope = & installed . declaration . scope ; let ordinal = installed . declaration . ordinal ; let site = generation_source_location (scope , ordinal) ; let key = meter . key (scope , site) ? ; meter . visit (site) ? ; let at = rows . generations . binary_search_by (| row | row . key . cmp (& key)) . map_err (| _ | meter . refused (StorageError :: CorruptHistory , site)) ? ; let row = & mut rows . generations [at] ; if installed . versions . len () != row . declaration . versions . len () || installed . closures . len () != row . declaration . closures . len () { return Err (meter . refused (StorageError :: CorruptHistory , site)) ; } meter . reserve (& mut row . versions , installed . versions . len () , site) ? ; for (position , & index) in installed . versions . iter () . enumerate () { let slot_site = generation_slot_location (scope , ordinal , "memory.generation_versions" , position) ; meter . visit (slot_site) ? ; if index != position { return Err (meter . refused (StorageError :: CorruptHistory , slot_site)) ; } row . versions . push (& row . declaration . versions [index]) ; } meter . reserve (& mut row . closures , installed . closures . len () , site) ? ; for (position , & index) in installed . closures . iter () . enumerate () { let slot_site = generation_slot_location (scope , ordinal , "memory.generation_closures" , position) ; meter . visit (slot_site) ? ; if index != position { return Err (meter . refused (StorageError :: CorruptHistory , slot_site)) ; } row . closures . push (& row . declaration . closures [index]) ; } } Ok (()) }
review.item_premise: The memory audit adapter checks a retained index inside the same bounded, observed audit invocation.
